Synopsis:
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's deliberate "no forward guidance" stance is under mounting pressure ahead of the July 28-29 FOMC meeting. PCE inflation has doubled to 4% YoY (vs. 2% target), breadth of price increases is widening (60% of PCE categories above 3% per Goldman), oil is back near $4/gallon, and new tariff threats loom. Multiple Fed governors and regional presidents (Waller, Hammack) are openly signaling rate hike readiness. Warsh's credibility buffer is eroding — the PCE index now runs ~5.5% above its on-target trajectory. Rate hold is still expected at this meeting, but coalition for a hike is actively forming.
